يشتهوا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَهُوا (yaštahū) /jaʃ.ta.huː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# يُشْتَهَوْا (yuštahaw) /juʃ.ta.haw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
